verdict.rationale: Docs show hardware can be ordered via the Management API or Customer Area (adyen-pos-docs-11, adyen-pos-docs-3, adyen-pos-docs-25) and Adyen offers a standalone terminal option for fast setup (adyen-pos-docs-4), but there is no evidence on signup/approval timelines, and a hands-on community report describes hundreds of hours spent integrating card-present/POS before ultimately abandoning Adyen (adyen-pos-comm-1), directly contradicting a 'same week' onboarding claim. missing for 10: evidence of signup/approval speed, independent confirmation that hardware ordering and go-live actually happens within a week, resolution of the contradicting integration-time complaint.
